title: Christ is Risen, He Is Risen Indeed!
lyrics_original: How can it be the One who died
Has borne our sin through sacrifice
To conquer every sting of death?
Sing, sing "Hallelujah!"
For joy awakes as dawning light
When Christ's disciples lift their eyes.
Alive He stands, their Friend and King:
Christ, Christ He is risen!
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
Oh sing "Hallelujah!"
Join the chorus sing with the redeemed:
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
Where doubt and darkness once had been,
They saw Him and their hearts believed;
But bless'd are those who have not seen,
Yet sing "Hallelujah!"
Once bound by fear, now bold in faith,
They preached the truth and pow'r of grace
And pouring out their lives they gained
Life, life everlasting.
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
Oh sing "Hallelujah!"
Join the chorus sing with the redeemed:
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
The power that raised Him from the grave
Now works in us to powerfully save
He frees our hearts to live His grace
Go tell of His goodness.
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
Oh sing "Hallelujah!"
Join the chorus sing with the redeemed:
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
Oh sing "Hallelujah!"
Join the chorus sing with the redeemed:
Christ is risen, He's risen indeed!
author_english: Keith Getty, Kristyn Getty, and Ed Cash

bible_verses.english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him.

For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

You, being dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, he made alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses, having blotted out the bond written in ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for bearing my sin upon the cross and rising victorious over death. My heart overflows with joy knowing that You are alive, my loving Friend and reigning King. Fill me today with the dawning light of Your resurrection power and peace. May my life be a continual song of hallelujah to Your glorious name. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The wonder of the cross leads us straight into the joy of the empty tomb. Jesus did not just carry our sins through sacrifice; He broke the power of death once and for all so that we might walk in vibrant hope. Like the early disciples whose grief turned to gladness at the sight of their risen King, our hearts are invited to awaken to His presence today. Let your voice rise in gratitude, declaring that Christ is alive and reigning forever.
